boundary: Rows are proposed review contracts, not operator agreements, permits, budgets, local baselines or service results.

rows.trigger_condition: grouped enterprise arrival and shuttle demand is dated
rows.pass_condition: public route and resident access remain open while the window is tested
rows.owner_role: enterprise transport coordinator with transit review
rows.action_if_fail: do not reserve curb capacity; return to public transport and human dispatch

rows.trigger_condition: grouped arrival windows and subsidy rule are published
rows.pass_condition: choice remains available without account or biometric access
rows.owner_role: enterprise mobility coordinator with community liaison
rows.action_if_fail: hold recommendation and return to human/public transport information

rows.trigger_condition: night return request has a human handoff and dated window
rows.pass_condition: the slowest group has a public-transit or staffed fallback
rows.action_if_fail: freeze booking and return to human/public transport

rows.trigger_condition: loading demand, fire clearance and clearing owner are recorded
rows.pass_condition: service window closes on time without blocking the route
rows.owner_role: field maintenance and traffic safety review
rows.action_if_fail: cancel reservation and restore open/emergency state with manual field marshal

rows.trigger_condition: grouped care trip and assisted-transfer route are reviewed
rows.pass_condition: human equivalent remains available at every handoff
rows.action_if_fail: hold automated suggestion and dispatch human assistance

rows.trigger_condition: continuous accessible route walkthrough is dated
rows.pass_condition: wheelchair and walking routes share visible handoff and retreat
rows.action_if_fail: close the service window and guide by the accessible human route

rows.trigger_condition: station interface, bicycle parking and last-mile route are inspected
rows.pass_condition: transfer is readable and does not displace emergency access
rows.action_if_fail: hold feeder option and keep staffed rail/bus and human station wayfinding open

rows.trigger_condition: event range, evacuation route and clearance owner are recorded
rows.pass_condition: public, logistics and emergency flows remain separable
rows.owner_role: event safety and field maintenance review
rows.action_if_fail: reduce or cancel rehearsal; use manual steward and restore public transport/emergency priority

rows.trigger_condition: weather, outage or rail disruption is dated and a human takeover list exists
rows.pass_condition: bookings freeze and the ground/public route covers the handoff
rows.owner_role: rail/bus operations, field maintenance and independent review
rows.action_if_fail: remain not_authorized_not_run and return to human/public transport

rows.trigger_condition: complaint, fault or service refusal is entered with a timestamp
rows.pass_condition: owner, response status, repair and independent review are readable
rows.owner_role: community service, field maintenance and independent review
rows.action_if_fail: do not close the case; return service to the human entry
rows.non_ai_equivalent: public desk, phone and paper complaint ledger
